text:
marco: Kicking off tri-region dry run for v2.4.1 rollout. Goal: validate surge handling and pin/rollback rules before tomorrow's change window. Starting at 14:00 PT. Observability + SRE, please watch latency and error SLOs.

deploy-bot: Dry-run job queued (job id 0x7f3a). Simulating 30min sustained ramp across US/EU/APAC with burst waves. Logs stream: https://ci.redwood/job/0x7f3a/logs :rocket:

priya: Thanks — quick heads up, APAC warm pool currently at 65% due to another customer burst. If we push full slice we risk preemption  — recommend limiting APAC to 10% in dry-run.

liam: Confirmed quota: APAC GPUs available but eviction risk is real for 2 contiguous waves. Can we do 3x smaller waves instead of single big push?

marco: Good call. Change plan: US 40%, EU 40%, APAC 10% for dry-run. If APAC looks stable after 15m, we'll bump to 25% for a second short wave.

ops-oncall: Rollback triggers restating for visibility:
- error rate > 1.5% sustained for 5m
- 95p latency increase > 2x baseline for 3m
- CPU/GPU throttling/oom events on >=2 nodes
If any trigger fires, immediate pin to previous model and route 100% to fallback.

sre_kate: Observability dashboards warming up. Key panels: per-region p95 latency, token/sec, grpc errors. Setting alert thresholds now.

deploy-bot: Dry-run started (0x7f3a) — wave 1: US 40% / EU 40% / APAC 10%. Streaming events: 
```
[14:00:12] wave:start id=1
[14:01:03] us.p95=210ms eu.p95=230ms apac.p95=520ms
[14:03:22] us.errors=0.2% eu.errors=0.3% apac.errors=1.1%
```

devex_ana: Drafted release note blurb for v2.4.1: "improved KV cache eviction heuristics, batching improvements for long-context sessions, and rollout controls for geo-slices." Putting it in the release doc; please review.

priya: APAC memory pressure up on one host, SRE noted KV miss spike in logs: `kv.cache.miss.rate` jumped x4 around 14:04. Not yet OOM but worth monitoring.

sre_kate: A few further datapoints: apac node n-23 showing transient GC + swap; p95 rose to 780ms at 14:06 but error rate stayed under 1.5%. We're throttling new sessions to that node.

liam: Suggest reducing APAC concurrency (per-pod) by 20% for the next wave and increase prefix caching TTL for APAC workloads to reduce KV churn. I can apply the change if approved.

marco: Approve reduce concurrency 20% for APAC and bump prefix TTL from 30s to 120s for the dry-run only. Keep EU/US unchanged.

deploy-bot: Applying runtime patch to APAC slices: `--concurrency-scale=0.8 --prefix-ttl=120s` (canary patch id 0x1c).

deploy-bot: Wave 2 starting in 3m: US 40% / EU 40% / APAC 25% (short 5m bump).

deploy-bot: Wave 2 events:
```
[14:12:01] wave:start id=2
[14:12:45] apac.p95=430ms apac.errors=0.9%
[14:14:10] us.p95=220ms eu.p95=240ms
```

ops-oncall: No rollback triggers yet. APAC p95 improved after the patch; keeping a 5m watch.

sre_kate: Noting a small uptick in redis latency for APAC region at 14:13 — correlating with prefix-ttl change but still within safe margins.

marco: Given the improvement, plan for tomorrow's rollout: initial ramp US 50 / EU 40 / APAC 10, then incremental APAC bump to 30% after 30m only if metrics remain stable. Pin rules documented in release ticket.

devex_ana: I'll update the release notes with the exact rollout percentages and known mitigations (APAC concurrency reduction fallback). Also adding a short FAQ on why APAC starts lower.

liam: Quick ops note: if APAC memory trend reappears, prefer auto-pin to previous model over traffic split workarounds. That's faster to recover.

marco: Agreed. Final decision: default auto-pin on memory OOM or 2+ nodes showing swap. ops-oncall will execute manual pin only if auto-pin didn't trigger.

deploy-bot: Dry-run complete (0x7f3a). Summary: no hard rollback triggers hit. APAC showed transient pressure but responded to concurrency and TTL patches. Logs and perf snapshots uploaded: https://ci.redwood/job/0x7f3a/artifacts

marco: Great work team. Action items: 1) devex_ana update release notes (in 30m) 2) ops-oncall please prepare rollback playbook doc 3) SRE to add one more alert for `kv.cache.miss.rate` spikes. We'll reconvene at 17:00 PT for final sign-off. :white_check_mark:

ops-oncall: Acknowledged, starting the rollback playbook draft now.

devex_ana: I'll have the release note update and FAQ by 14:30 PT.

sre_kate: Adding the kv miss alert and an APAC-specific memory dashboard panel now.

marco: Thanks. Closing thread for live commentary — post any follow-ups here.
